theorems.name: Submission.rectifiability_bf_fibre_cone_comparison
theorems.statement: ∀ (N m : ℕ) (μ : Measure (Eucl N)) (δ : ℝ) (a : Eucl N) (u : Fin (m + 1) → Eucl N), (∀ j : Fin N, limsup (fun t : ℝ => ⨆ r ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ, μ (ball a r ∩ {x | x ≠ a ∧ ∃ c ∈ ball (0 : Eucl (m + 1)) t, (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i : Fin (m + 1) => inner ℝ (u i + c i • EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ)) (x - a)) : Eucl (m + 1)) = 0}) / ENNReal.ofReal ((r * t) ^ (m + 1))) (𝓝[>] 0) ≤ limsup (fun s : ℝ => ⨆ r ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ, μ {x | dist x a < r ∧ ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i : Fin (m + 1) => inner ℝ (u i) (x - a)) : Eucl (m + 1))‖ < s * ‖x - a‖} / ENNReal.ofReal ((r * s) ^ (m + 1))) (𝓝[>] 0)) ∧ limsup (fun s : ℝ => ⨆ r ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ, μ {x | dist x a < r ∧ ‖(WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i : Fin (m + 1) => inner ℝ (u i) (x - a)) : Eucl (m + 1))‖ < s * ‖x - a‖} / ENNReal.ofReal ((r * s) ^ (m + 1))) (𝓝[>] 0) ≤ ENNReal.ofReal (Real.sqrt (N : ℝ) ^ (m + 1)) * ∑ j : Fin N, limsup (fun t : ℝ => ⨆ r ∈ Ioo (0 : ℝ) δ, μ (ball a r ∩ {x | x ≠ a ∧ ∃ c ∈ ball (0 : Eucl (m + 1)) t, (WithLp.toLp 2 (fun i : Fin (m + 1) => inner ℝ (u i + c i • EuclideanSpace.single j (1 : ℝ)) (x - a)) : Eucl (m + 1)) = 0}) / ENNReal.ofReal ((r * t) ^ (m + 1))) (𝓝[>] 0)
theorems.natural_summary: Implements the independently reviewed natural-language proof; see the theorem issue and retained proof.
